description: Which root owns each semantic dimension. Derived from how the lexicon already behaves rather than invented: `before` is temporal in all 16 compounds that use it, `after` in all 11, and `back` is spatial in 7 of its 8. The lone exception is `elder` (person+back), where a spatial root carries a temporal sense. Nothing enforced this convention, so the exception froze in place under a playtest lock.
enforcement: advisory-only: reported by scripts/fonoran-verify-invariants.js, does not fail CI. Detection uses a gloss heuristic, not a semantic proof, so a hit needs a human read. Promoting this to a hard rule needs a per-concept sense field on the concept seeds.

dimensions.usage_note: 7 of 8 compounds using `back` are spatial. `elder` is the exception.

sense_markers.note: Words in a gloss that indicate the concept is about time. Used to spot a spatial root standing in for a temporal one.
